docstring: The least common multiple bound implies $n_k \le \exp((1 + o(1))k)$.
references: [ErSe83] Erdos, P. and Selfridge, J. L., Problem 6447. Amer. Math. Monthly (1983), 710.
[Gu04] Guy, Richard K., _Unsolved problems in number theory_. (2004), Problem B31.
[Mo85] Monier, Jean-Marie, _Problems and Solutions: Solutions of Advanced Problems: 6447_. Amer. Math. Monthly **92** (1985), 435-436.
type_pretty: ∃ f, Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ), ↑(Erdos1063.n k) ≤ Real.exp ((1 + f k) * ↑k)
